# Web 4 — delegation/1, the agentic internet as open protocols
# delegation/1 is the vendor-neutral specification for cryptographically provable delegated authority for agents — a chain that runs human, organisation, agent, sub-agent, session and can never grow on the way down.
# The human front door to the stack: the map, the principles, and how a protocol joins.
# No repository on the map is public or launched today; this site makes zero external requests.

## Pages
- https://flashylabs.github.io/flashyid-spec/ — the pitch and the nine-layer table, rendered from stack.json.
- https://flashylabs.github.io/flashyid-spec/stack/ — every layer, its question, its repositories and its status.
- https://flashylabs.github.io/flashyid-spec/principles/ — the five refusals the estate builds by.
- https://flashylabs.github.io/flashyid-spec/joining/ — the five-rung ladder a protocol climbs to become a standard.
- https://flashylabs.github.io/flashyid-spec/why/ — the argument for the stack, layer by layer.
- https://flashylabs.github.io/flashyid-spec/faq/ — six honest answers, with FAQPage structured data.

## Machine surfaces (byte copies of their sources)
- https://flashylabs.github.io/flashyid-spec/.well-known/stack.json — the web4/1 machine twin of the map.
- https://flashylabs.github.io/flashyid-spec/.well-known/flashyos.json — the flashyos/1 mesh handshake, derived from the AAO charter.
- https://flashylabs.github.io/flashyid-spec/.well-known/flashyos-charter.json — the AAO charter this org is provisioned from.
- https://flashylabs.github.io/flashyid-spec/.well-known/directory.json — this org's directory/1 node.

The machine twin is maintained at https://github.com/FlashyLabs/flashyid-spec; this repository is https://github.com/FlashyLabs/flashyid-spec.
